category: Public Spotweb instance exposing a Newznab API

free_tier.stated: No account and no key. /api?t=caps returned 2,128 bytes with <limits max="500" default="50"/> and <registration available="no" open="no"/>; /api?t=search&q=linux returned 41,244 bytes with 50 items; /api?t=g&id=... returned a 7,346-byte NZB.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable per object; at most 500 results per request per caps

retention.stated: not published. Spotnet-derived catalogue; depth follows the Spotnet post history.

interface_detail: Newznab-shaped API at /api, caps type Spotweb version 0.1, with search, tv-search and get. No apikey was required.
tooling: Works as a generic Newznab indexer in Prowlarr and NZBHydra2, and therefore in Sonarr, Radarr and Lidarr, with no wrapper and no key. Same Spotweb surface as nzbserver.com.
chaining: A second hostname for the same anonymous Spotnet index; useful as failover for nzbserver.com, not as extra coverage.

limits.value: none observed: 3 requests in one session, all 200
500 results per request maximum per caps

limits_note: The 500/50 clamp was measured on the twin instance nzbserver.com, where limit=501 returns the 50-result default; the same code is running here (identical caps shape).
binding_note: No counter to hit; the same result-clamp caveat as nzbserver.com.

identity_cost.detail: Nothing: registration is declared unavailable and no key was needed for caps, search or get.

reliability_note: Volunteer-run Spotweb instance with a stock placeholder email in caps; the NZB it served was byte-identical to nzbserver.com's, so the two go down together only if the shared backend does.
confidence_note: caps, search and download measured. The clamp detail is carried from the twin instance and is labelled as such rather than claimed as measured here.

evidence.proved: caps returned 200 and 2,128 bytes: type Spotweb, limits max 500 default 50, registration unavailable
anonymous Newznab search returned 200 and 41,244 bytes with 50 items (sha256 3ca43b75...)
anonymous NZB download returned 200, 7,346 bytes, 10 files, sha256 ac230711... identical to nzbserver.com's

notes: Listed in a community index of Usenet indexers as 'No accounts, Free'. Its caps is a stock Spotweb default, so it is a second front end rather than a separately curated index.
